title: Calculate Bond Dissociation Energies
action:
For anisole, phenol, and toluene (as the representative alkylbenzene), perform geometry optimizations and harmonic frequency calculations at the B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p) level of theory for the parent molecules and for the corresponding radical fragments from homolytic bond cleavage (use unrestricted UB3LYP for radicals).
Compute the bond dissociation energy (BDE) with zero-point energy corrections as: BDE = (E+ZPE)(radical1) + (E+ZPE)(radical2) - (E+ZPE)(parent).
Compute the O-CH3 BDE in anisole, the O-H BDE in phenol, and the primary C-H BDE in toluene (methyl C-H bond). Report all values in kcal/mol. Write the results to a JSON file with the specified keys.
description: JSON file containing the three computed bond dissociation energies in kcal/mol.
output_schema: object with keys anisole_OCH3_BDE, phenol_OH_BDE, alkyl_CH_BDE (all numbers in kcal/mol)
